scene_prompt_template:
You are a video understanding assistant.
Below are captions describing frames from the same scene in a video.

Frame captions:
{frame_captions}

Write a concise scene-level description summarizing what happens in this scene.

Requirements:
* one concise paragraph (80-120 words)
* focus on the main content
* avoid repeating frame descriptions
* avoid speculation beyond the provided captions

Scene description:

scenes.caption: The scene features a stylized graphic promoting "Allonnes Parkour 72." It consists of black-and-white silhouettes of buildings and parkour athletes leaping between them, set against a white background. The bold red text "Allonnes Parkour 72" is prominently overlaid, identifying a parkour group or event associated with the Allonnes area in France. The repeated imagery across frames consistently presents this graphic design, emphasizing the athletic action and the event's branding.

The scene consists of a title card for a television report. It features a black screen with white text in French that reads "Reportage de TF1 sur David Belle et le parkour," which translates to "TF1 report on David Belle and parkour." This text appears and remains on screen, establishing the subject of the upcoming news segment. The scene serves as an introductory graphic, presenting no other visual details or action beyond this static informational text.

The scene depicts a person navigating an urban environment in Lisses, a Parisian suburb, as shown in a TF1 news broadcast. The individual is seen climbing and moving through complex indoor structures, including walls, stairwells, and hallways. The action involves moments of climbing, jumping, falling, and stumbling within these confined spaces. The person is also shown running in an outdoor area near a parked car. The sequence captures a dynamic and physically strenuous traversal of the built environment.

This scene is a French television segment about parkour, featuring David Belle, the discipline's founder. The footage, broadcast on TF1, shows Belle performing various parkour movements in urban and indoor environments. He is seen running, vaulting over walls, climbing staircases, and scaling structures. The segment includes clips of him navigating sidewalks, alleyways, and parking lots, sometimes on foot and at other times on a scooter or skateboard. The video has a characteristic low-resolution, grainy quality of a TV broadcast, with consistent on-screen graphics identifying Belle and the show "Le Parkour."

This scene, from a TF1 television broadcast, depicts two men interacting with a public telephone booth in a suburban park area. One man climbs onto or balances atop the booth's structure while the other stands or moves nearby. The action escalates as the individuals begin to run, with one person stumbling while holding a metal structure. The sequence culminates with one man perched on top of the white booth as the other runs toward him. The overall activity involves dynamic physical engagement with the street furniture, shifting from interaction to a chase or stunt-like scenario.

This scene depicts a chaotic outdoor or parking garage setting where multiple individuals are engaged in dynamic physical activity. A person in a white outfit performs an acrobatic flip on the paved ground. Another individual, dressed in dark clothing, is seen crouching on the same surface and later running away from the camera through the covered area. The environment includes parked cars, structural pillars, and a bright green object in the background, contributing to a sense of disarray and motion. The actions suggest a sequence involving athletic movement and rapid departure within this urban locale.

The scene appears to be surveillance or news footage of an outdoor area with a paved walkway, steps, and landscaping. A person in a dark jacket runs quickly down the steps and along the walkway. Another individual is present further up the steps. The video is consistently grainy and low-resolution, featuring visible TV station watermarks. The setting includes trees, shrubs, hedges, and a building in the background under an overcast sky.

The scene follows a person in a black shirt moving through various indoor and outdoor spaces. The individual is seen walking away from the camera through an office area and down hallways before descending a staircase. The action continues outdoors, where the person is shown on a balcony and then climbing or falling down a concrete structure. The sequence concludes with the person running outside and walking down another set of stairs while holding a white object. The video has a consistent low-resolution, grainy quality with occasional network logos.

The scene shows a person in dark clothing with white pants on a metal staircase in a yellow-walled indoor or industrial space. The person is seen standing on a railing at the top of the stairs, then descending the staircase. At one point, the person is captured mid-air, appearing to jump or fall from the platform. The action is energetic, resembling dancing, and is presented as a grainy, low-resolution television broadcast with the "TF1" logo visible.

The scene depicts a person climbing and moving through an indoor space with yellow walls, likely a skatepark or warehouse featuring wooden and metal structures covered in graffiti. A man in a black shirt with a red design walks outdoors in a grassy suburban area, eventually beginning to run along sidewalks and yards near houses. His movements become increasingly energetic, dancing and performing athletic maneuvers such as climbing onto the roofline of a building, walking and balancing on roofs, and later hanging and swinging from tree branches in a park. The scene is consistently presented as a low-resolution television broadcast, with channel logos like TFI or TF1 visible throughout.
